current.text: Josh projects Marshall as Dallas's sixth man. His projected starting five is Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Cooper Flagg, P.J. Washington and Morez Johnson Jr.
Josh expects Marshall to lose his point guard role because Dallas now has three new point guards on the roster.
Josh sees Marshall as a streaming option who will have hot streaks, not a steady hold.
Dallas has a crowded group of wings and forwards who expect minutes, and Marshall is one of them.
Dusty May is the new Dallas head coach, so the rotation is not settled.
Dallas plays 4 games in each of our playoff weeks (4-4-4), probably the best playoff schedule. It also has the league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: Josh calls Marshall a non-shooting forward and a terrible shooter. He does not expect him to ever become a reliable shooter.

note: Yahoo ranks Marshall 204 and ESPN ranks him 208. Both sites value him at 0 USD, so he should go undrafted in our 144-player auction. Projections have his minutes and shots dropping from last season's 15.2 points on 11.1 shots, and his only real plus is a solid FG% (about 50%) with few threes and almost no blocks. Leave him on waivers. In the first weeks, check whether Dusty May gives him ball-handling duties or starter minutes, and keep him in mind as a streamer during hot stretches and in Dallas's 4-4-4 playoff weeks.
